result.instructions: Tools for MightyCall, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which calls did we miss yesterday, and who called back?"; "List the unread voicemails from this week with the caller numbers."; "Show the open journal requests for our sales line and mark request 5d84b8218558e842981cebf4 as resolved.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MightyCall data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mightycall_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mightycall_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mightycall_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mightycall_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mightycall_get_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Return the MightyCall user that the connected API key belongs to: name, email, extension and role.

tools.name: mightycall_list_phone_numbers
tools.title: List business phone numbers
tools.description: List the business phone numbers linked to the MightyCall account.

tools.name: mightycall_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List calls in a time window (UTC). Default window is the last day. Filter by one call type or a search text.

startUtc.description: Start of the window, UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.

endUtc.description: End of the window, UTC, e.g. 2026-11-08T00:00:00.

callFilter.description: One call type, e.g. Missed or Voicemail.

customFilter.description: Search text (caller or called number, name).

extension.description: Only calls on this extension number.

tools.name: mightycall_get_call
tools.title: Get a call
tools.description: Return one call by its id, including the caller, the called parties and the call record.

tools.name: mightycall_list_voicemails
tools.title: List voicemails
tools.description: List voicemails in a time window (UTC). Filter by read state or by a search text.

startUtc.description: Start of the window, UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.

endUtc.description: End of the window, UTC, e.g. 2026-11-08T00:00:00.

customFilter.description: Search text (caller or called name or number).

tools.name: mightycall_get_voicemail
tools.title: Get a voicemail
tools.description: Return one voicemail by its id, including its caller, time, duration and record.

tools.name: mightycall_list_journal_requests
tools.title: List journal requests
tools.description: List journal requests (the call and message log that drives the contact-center workflow). Filter by direction, outcome, workflow state, phone number or time window (UTC).

wfState.description: Workflow state: Open, Finished, Resolved or All.

isRead.description: Read or unread voicemails. Use only with inbound VoiceMail.

phone.description: Client phone numbers, comma separated, e.g. +15554553000.

businessNumber.description: Business numbers without a plus sign, comma separated.

from.description: Start of the period, UTC, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

to.description: End of the period, UTC, e.g. 2026-11-08T00:00:00Z.

searchProperty.description: Where to search the text: Client, BusinessNumber, Comment or VTT.

tools.name: mightycall_get_journal_request
tools.title: Get a journal request
tools.description: Return one journal request by its id, including its state, contacts and comment.

tools.name: mightycall_set_workflow_state
tools.title: Set workflow state of journal requests
tools.description: Set the workflow state (Open or Resolved) of one or more journal requests. Changes live data in the account.

requestIds.description: The journal request ids to update.

annotations.title: Set workflow state of journal requests
